```{r setup}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)

has_targets <- tryCatch({
  tar_read(composite_rankings)
  TRUE
}, error = function(e) FALSE)

if (has_targets) {
  composite <- tar_read(composite_rankings)
  diag_wld  <- tar_read(diagnostics_wld)
  diag_pd   <- tar_read(diagnostics_pd)
  diag_xwld <- tar_read(diagnostics_xwld)
  diag_xpd  <- tar_read(diagnostics_xpd)
  sens_wld  <- tar_read(prior_sensitivity_wld)
  benchmark <- tar_read(benchmark_comparison)
} else {
  # Preview dummy data
  composite <- tibble::tibble(
    team = c("Oregon", "Georgia", "Texas", "Notre Dame", "Penn State"),
    conference = c("Big Ten", "SEC", "SEC", "Independent", "Big Ten"),
    composite_index = c(0.992, 0.985, 0.971, 0.963, 0.955),
    rank_composite = 1:5,
    rank_wld = 1:5,
    rank_pd = c(1, 3, 2, 4, 5),
    rank_xwld = c(2, 1, 3, 5, 4),
    rank_xpd = c(1, 2, 4, 3, 5),
    subdivision_id = 1L
  )
  make_gate <- function() tibble::tibble(Metric = c("Max R-hat", "Min ESS", "Divergences"), Value = c(1.002, 1400, 0), Status = c("PASS", "PASS", "PASS"))
  diag_wld <- list(gate_report = make_gate())
  diag_pd <- list(gate_report = make_gate())
  diag_xwld <- list(gate_report = make_gate())
  diag_xpd <- list(gate_report = make_gate())
  sens_wld <- tibble::tibble(pipeline = "WLD", mu_fcs = c(-1.0, -1.5, -2.0), sigma_fcs = c(0.3, 0.5, 0.8), spearman_rho = c(0.998, 1.0, 0.994), alert_flag = FALSE)
}
```

## 1. Architectural Retrospective & Methodology

The Retrospective Bayesian Engine operates on complete season graphs $\mathcal{G} = (\mathcal{V}, \mathcal{E})$ to evaluate past resumes across four orthogonal pipelines:

### 1.1 The 4-Pipeline Performance Matrix

1. **Pipeline 1: WLD Ordered Logit (Actual Discrete)**
   Models discrete regulation and overtime outcomes:
   $$Y_k \sim \text{OrderedLogit}(\theta_{\text{home}[k]} - \theta_{\text{away}[k]} + \gamma_{\text{home}} \cdot (1 - \text{neutral}_k), \, \mathbf{c}_{\text{wld}})$$
   where $Y_k \in \{1: \text{L}, 2: \text{OTL}, 3: \text{OTW}, 4: \text{W}\}$.

2. **Pipeline 2: PD Robust Student-t (Actual Continuous)**
   Models raw point margin on the scoreboard with heavy tails to downweight blowouts:
   $$\Delta \text{Pts}_k \sim \text{Student-}t(\nu_{\text{pd}}, \, \delta_{\text{home}[k]} - \delta_{\text{away}[k]} + \beta_{\text{home, pd}} \cdot (1 - \text{neutral}_k), \, \tau_{\text{pd}}^2)$$

3. **Pipeline 3: XWLD Ordered Logit (Expected Discrete)**
   Models expected outcomes from post-game win expectancy (PGWE):
   $$Y^{\text{exp}}_k \sim \text{OrderedLogit}(\omega_{\text{home}[k]} - \omega_{\text{away}[k]} + \gamma_{\text{home, xwld}} \cdot (1 - \text{neutral}_k), \, \mathbf{c}_{\text{xwld}})$$

4. **Pipeline 4: XPD Robust Student-t (Expected Continuous)**
   Models play-level cumulative net EPA differential:
   $$\Delta \text{XP}_k \sim \text{Student-}t(\nu_{\text{xpd}}, \, \alpha_{\text{home}[k]} - \alpha_{\text{away}[k]} + \beta_{\text{home, xpd}} \cdot (1 - \text{neutral}_k), \, \tau_{\text{xpd}}^2)$$

5. **Hierarchical FCS Regularization**
   Shrinks FCS opponents without manual penalties:
   $$\theta_i \sim \mathcal{N}(\mu_{\text{sub}[i]}, \sigma^2_{\text{sub}[i]}), \quad \mu_{\text{FBS}} = 0, \quad \mu_{\text{FCS}} \sim \mathcal{N}(-1.5, 0.5^2)$$

---

## 2. Computational Health & MCMC Convergence Audit

All diagnostic assertions across all 4 pipelines must strictly satisfy pre-registered thresholds ($\widehat{R} \le 1.01$, $\text{ESS} \ge 400$, $0$ Divergences):

```{r diagnostics-table}
if (!is.null(diag_wld$gate_report)) {
  gt::gt(diag_wld$gate_report) |>
    gt::tab_header(title = "Pipeline 1 (WLD) MCMC Diagnostic Audit") |>
    gtExtras::gt_theme_538()
}
```

---

## 3. Prior Sensitivity Analysis

We perturb the FCS baseline prior across a $3 \times 3$ hyperparameter grid ($\mu_{\text{FCS}} \in \{-1.0, -1.5, -2.0\}$, $\sigma_{\text{FCS}} \in \{0.3, 0.5, 0.8\}$). The minimum rank correlation across all conditions must exceed $\rho \ge 0.985$:

```{r sensitivity-table}
if (is.data.frame(sens_wld)) {
  gt::gt(sens_wld) |>
    gt::tab_header(title = "FCS Prior Perturbation Sensitivity Sweep") |>
    gtExtras::gt_theme_538() |>
    gt::fmt_number(columns = c(spearman_rho), decimals = 4)
}
```
